newsitem.title: DENMARK: POLL-DANISH MAY-JUNE RETAIL SALES INDEX SEEN UP. [CORRECTED 11:23 GMT]
newsitem.headline: POLL-DANISH MAY-JUNE RETAIL SALES INDEX SEEN UP. [CORRECTED 11:23 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and throughout from "retail price index")
Eight analysts in a Reuters survey done on Monday predict, on average, a 2.1-percent rise in Denmark's May and June retail sales index, up from a 1.1-percent gain in March-April.
Estimates ranged between up 1.1 percent and 2.8 percent for the index, due at 0730 GMT on Wednesday.
"Retail sales are expected to rise again in May-June after taking a breather in March-April, fuelled by falling interest rates and rising house prices," said Unidanmark economist Jesper Nielsen.
Another analyst said a major rise in May Danish car purchases to avoid new higher road taxes also contributed to the expected retail sales index.
